claim: ApexBrasil announced on 4 November that about 200 Brazilian companies will take part in Web Summit Lisbon.
Brazil's pavilion at Web Summit Lisbon is 324 square metres and located in the MEO Arena.
The Brazil pavilion programme runs from 10 to 12 November.
ApexBrasil leads the Brazilian mission with Sebrae Startups, running from 8 to 13 November.
The Brazilian mission includes representatives of ten Brazilian technology parks.
Brazilian companies raised about 700 million US dollars at earlier Web Summit editions.
Intuitivo was founded in Porto in 2021.
Intuitivo covers more than 500 schools in Portugal and has 75,000 registered teachers, according to Portugal Startup News.
Intuitivo has raised €1.35 million in seed funding to grow in Brazil.
Intuitivo estimates Brazil's market at 2.2 million teachers, about 12 times Portugal's.
